preconditions.description: The first line contains exactly one integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 32768), and the second line contains exactly n integers a₁, a₂, ..., aₙ (0 ≤ aᵢ < 32768).

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == n for _ in range(1)) and all(0 <= int(out) <= 32768 for out in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, each representing the minimum number of operations to reduce the corresponding aᵢ to 0.

postconditions.expression: all(int(out) == min_steps(a_i) for a_i, out in zip(map(int, stdin.split()[1:]), stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: For each aᵢ in the input, the corresponding output value is the minimum number of operations (increment or multiply by 2 modulo 32768) required to reduce aᵢ to 0.
